launchFeedback.noteRequired.en: Add an authorization note before launching on the producer’s behalf.
launchFeedback.noteRequired.zh: 代制片方投放前，请填写授权说明。

launchFeedback.noteHelp.en: Required for staff launches. Record who authorized this launch; a producer approver can approve directly from their own account.
launchFeedback.noteHelp.zh: 工作人员代投时必填。请记录谁授权了本次投放；制片方审批人可使用自己的账户直接批准。

launchFeedback.previewFirst.en: Preview the current campaign plan before launching.
launchFeedback.previewFirst.zh: 请先预览当前广告活动方案，再提交投放。

launchFeedback.chooseProducer.en: Choose a producer company above to save and preview its launch.
launchFeedback.chooseProducer.zh: 先在上方选择制片公司，再保存并预览投放。

launchFeedback.cannotEdit.en: Your current account can view this company, but cannot create launches. Sign in with its producer editor or approver account.
launchFeedback.cannotEdit.zh: 当前账户可以查看这家公司，但不能创建投放。请使用该公司的编辑或审批人账户登录。

launchFeedback.pausedConfirmation.en: The campaigns will be created paused. They will not spend until an authorized user resumes them.
launchFeedback.pausedConfirmation.zh: 广告活动将以暂停状态创建，授权用户开启后才会产生花费。

launchFeedback.liveConfirmation.en: The campaigns will be enabled and may begin spending after platform review. Confirm the accounts, content and budget in your preview before continuing.
launchFeedback.liveConfirmation.zh: 广告活动将启用，通过平台审核后可能开始花费。继续前，请确认预览中的账户、素材和预算。

launchFeedback.previewHelp.en: Click Preview campaigns to check your plan. The approval and launch button appears after a successful preview; previewing does not create ads.
launchFeedback.previewHelp.zh: 点击“预览广告活动”检查方案。预览通过后会显示批准并投放按钮；预览不会创建广告。

launchFeedback.launchHelp.en: Launch on {provider} opens your campaign plan for approval. Confirm the accounts, content and budget to create the ads.
launchFeedback.launchHelp.zh: 点击“投放到 {provider}”打开方案审批窗口，确认账户、素材和预算后创建广告。

launchFeedback.realCreation.en: Confirming creates real {provider} ads in the selected accounts.
launchFeedback.realCreation.zh: 确认后，将在所选账户中创建真实的 {provider} 广告。

launchFeedback.testCreation.en: Test launch: this will not create real {provider} ads.
launchFeedback.testCreation.zh: 测试投放：不会创建真实的 {provider} 广告。
